name: europa-civilization-video
description: A 9:16 cinematic short on the history of European civilization — visuals and soundtrack generated entirely by code.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Europa out/europa.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 3
scripts.cover: remotion still src/index.ts Cover-3x4 out/cover_3x4.png && remotion still src/index.ts Cover-9x16 out/cover_9x16.png
scripts.build: npm run music && npm run render
